Name: FishPriceBySize
Author: xjx2005
Description:
FishPriceBySize adds realistic fish sizes and size-based pricing to Stardew Valley.

Features:

- Fish have individual sizes measured in centimeters.
- Fish can range from small/young fish to large adult specimens.
- Every additional 1 cm increases the original fish price by 1%.
- Fish with different sizes cannot be stacked.
- Fish size is displayed in the fish name.
- The fish name also displays the current price.
- The same fish size is preserved between catching and inventory.
打开背包就可以直接知道这条鱼有多大 值多少钱 不需要额外查看 Mod 菜单
Mod 会记录鱼实际钓到的尺寸 并保存到鱼本身
因此：钓鱼结果 → 鱼的尺寸 → 背包 → 鱼名称 → 售价
使用的是同一个尺寸数据
不会出现钓鱼时显示一个尺寸，放进背包后又变成另一个尺寸的问题
让每一次钓鱼都不只是“钓到一条鱼”，而是：
“我今天钓到了一条多大的鱼？”
从小鱼到巨型鱼，每条鱼都有属于自己的尺寸和价值
祝你钓到属于自己的巨物！ 🎣
-Installation Path:
Stardew Valley/Mods/FishPriceBySize/
